newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net reserves rise to $21.60 bln in October.
newsitem.headline: Polish net reserves rise to $21.60 bln in October.

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves grew by $164.7 million in October to $21.60 billion and were $2.71 billion higher than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said the reserves grew $1.16 billion in the January-October period compared to a $7.60 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) OCT 96 SEPT 96 OCT 95
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
